verses.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
verses.pt: E cinco dias depois, desceu o sumo sacerdote Ananias, com os anciãos e um certo orador Tértulo; os quais compareceram diante do governador contra Paulo.
verses.en_web: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.
verses.en_bbe: And after five days, the high priest, Ananias, came with certain of the rulers, and an expert talker, one Tertullus; and they made a statement to Felix against Paul.

verses.en: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,
verses.pt: E sendo chamado, Tértulo começou a acusá -lo, dizendo:
verses.en_web: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,
verses.en_bbe: And when he had been sent for, Tertullus, starting his statement, said, Because by you we are living in peace, and through your wisdom wrongs are put right for this nation,

verses.en: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
verses.pt: Visto que há muita paz por causa de ti, e que por teu governo muitos bons serviços estão sendo feitos a esta nação, excelentíssimo Félix, totalmente e em todo lugar, com todo agradecimento o reconhecemos.
verses.en_web: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
verses.en_bbe: In all things and in all places we are conscious of our great debt to you, most noble Felix.

verses.en: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
verses.pt: Mas para que eu não gaste muito o teu tempo, rogo -te que tu nos ouças brevemente, conforme a tua clemência.
verses.en_web: But, that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
verses.en_bbe: But, so that I may not make you tired, I make a request to you of your mercy, to give hearing to a short statement.

verses.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
verses.pt: Porque nós temos achado que este homem é uma peste, e levantador de rebeliões entre todos os judeus pelo mundo, e o principal defensor da seita dos nazarenos.
verses.en_web: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
verses.en_bbe: For this man, in our opinion, is a cause of trouble, a maker of attacks on the government among Jews through all the empire, and a chief mover in the society of the Nazarenes:

verses.en: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
verses.pt: O qual também tentou profanar o Templo; ao qual também prendemos, e quisemos julgar conforme a nossa Lei.
verses.en_web: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.
verses.en_bbe: Who, in addition, was attempting to make the Temple unclean: whom we took,

verses.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,
verses.pt: Mas tendo vindo sobre nós o comandante Lísias, com grande violência, tirou -o das nossas mãos;
verses.en_web: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,

verses.en: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
verses.pt: investigando-o tu mesmo, poderás entender todas estas coisas das quais o acusamos.
verses.en_web: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”
verses.en_bbe: And from whom you will be able, by questioning him yourself, to get knowledge of all the things which we say against him.

verses.en: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
verses.pt: E os judeus também concordaram, dizendo serem estas coisas assim.
verses.en_web: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.
verses.en_bbe: And the Jews were in agreement with his statement, saying that these things were so.

verses.en: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
verses.pt: Mas Paulo, fazendo gesto ao governador para que falasse, respondeu: Sabendo eu que por muitos anos tu tens sido juiz desta nação, com maior ânimo eu me defendo.
verses.en_web: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,
verses.en_bbe: Then when the ruler had given him a sign to make his answer, Paul said, Because I have knowledge that you have been a judge over this nation for a number of years, I am glad to make my answer:

verses.en: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
verses.pt: Pois tu podes entender que há não mais que doze dias, eu tinha subido a Jerusalém para adorar.
verses.en_web: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: Seeing that you are able to make certain of the fact that it is not more than twelve days from the time when I came up to Jerusalem for worship;

verses.en: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
verses.pt: E nem me acharam falando com alguém no Templo, nem incitando ao povo, nem nas sinagogas, nem na cidade.
verses.en_web: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues, or in the city.
verses.en_bbe: And they have not seen me in argument with any man in the Temple, or working up the feelings of the people, in the Synagogues or in the town:

verses.en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
verses.pt: E nem podem provar as coisas das quais agora estão me acusando.
verses.en_web: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
verses.en_bbe: And they are not able to give facts in support of the things which they say against me now.

verses.en: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
verses.pt: Mas isto eu te confesso, que conforme o Caminho que eles chamam de seita, assim eu sirvo ao Deus dos meus pais, crendo em tudo que está escrito na Lei e nos profetas;
verses.en_web: But this I confess to you, that after the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;
verses.en_bbe: But this I will say openly to you, that I do give worship to the God of our fathers after that Way, which to them is not the true religion: but I have belief in all the things which are in the law and in the books of the prophets:

verses.en: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
verses.pt: Tendo esperança em Deus, ao qual estes mesmos também esperam, que vai haver ressurreição dos mortos, tanto dos justos como dos injustos.
verses.en_web: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
verses.en_bbe: Hoping in God for that which they themselves are looking for, that there will be a coming back from the dead for upright men and wrongdoers.

verses.en: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
verses.pt: E nisto eu pratico, em que tanto para com Deus como para com os seres humanos eu sempre tenha uma consciência limpa.
verses.en_web: Herein I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
verses.en_bbe: And in this, I do my best at all times to have no reason for shame before God or men.

verses.en: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
verses.pt: E muitos anos depois, vim para fazer doações e ofertas à minha nação.
verses.en_web: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;
verses.en_bbe: Now after a number of years I came to give help and offerings to my nation:

verses.en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
verses.pt: Nisto, tendo eu me purificado, nem com multidões, nem com tumulto, alguns judeus da Ásia me acharam,
verses.en_web: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.
verses.en_bbe: And having been made clean, I was in the Temple, but not with a great number of people, and not with noise: but there were certain Jews from Asia,

verses.en: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
verses.pt: Os quais era necessário que estivessem aqui presentes diante de ti, se tivessem alguma coisa contra mim.
verses.en_web: They ought to have been here before you, and to make accusation, if they had anything against me.
verses.en_bbe: And it would have been better if they had come here to make a statement, if they have anything against me.

verses.en: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
verses.pt: Ou digam estes mesmos, se eles acharam alguma má ação em mim quando eu estava perante o supremo conselho;
verses.en_web: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
verses.en_bbe: Or let these men here present say what wrongdoing was seen in me when I was before the Sanhedrin,

verses.en: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
verses.pt: A não ser somente esta palavra com que, quando eu estava entre eles, clamei, que pela ressurreição dos mortos eu estou sendo julgado hoje por vós.
verses.en_web: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”
verses.en_bbe: But only this one thing which I said among them in a loud voice, I am this day being judged on the question of the coming back from the dead.

verses.en: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
verses.pt: Tendo ouvido estas coisas, Félix, que sabia mais detalhadamente sobre o Caminho, adiou-lhes, dizendo: Quando o comandante Lísias descer, eu procurarei saber melhor de vossos assuntos.
verses.en_web: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”
verses.en_bbe: But Felix, who had a more detailed knowledge of the Way, put them off, saying, When Lysias, the chief captain, comes down, I will give attention to your business.

verses.en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
verses.pt: E ele mandou ao centurião que guardassem a Paulo, e estivesse com alguma liberdade, e impedir a ninguém dos seus amigos lhe prestasse serviço, ou vir até ele.
verses.en_web: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody, and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders to the captain to keep Paul under his control, and to let him have everything he had need of; and not to keep his friends from coming to see him.

verses.en: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
verses.pt: E alguns dias depois, tendo vindo Félix com a mulher dele Drusila, que era judia, mandou chamar a Paulo, e o ouviu sobre a fé em Cristo.
verses.en_web: But after some days, Felix came with Drusilla, his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: But after some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was of the Jews by birth, and sent for Paul, and gave hearing to him about faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
verses.pt: E ele, tendo discursado sobre a justiça, o domínio próprio, e o julgamento que está por vir, Félix temeu, e respondeu: Por agora vai; e tendo outra oportunidade, eu te chamarei.
verses.en_web: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”
verses.en_bbe: And while he was talking about righteousness and self-control and the judging which was to come, Felix had great fear and said, Go away for the present, and when the right time comes I will send for you.

verses.en: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
verses.pt: Ele também esperava que lhe fosse dado algum dinheiro por Paulo, para que o soltasse; por isso ele também muitas vezes o mandava chamar, e conversava com ele.
verses.en_web: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often, and talked with him.
verses.en_bbe: For he was hoping that Paul would give him money: so he sent for him more frequently and had talk with him.

verses.en: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix’ room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
verses.pt: Mas tendo completado dois anos, Félix teve por sucessor a Pórcio Festo. E Félix, querendo agradar dos judeus, deixou Paulo preso.
verses.en_web: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.
verses.en_bbe: But after two years Porcius Festus took the place of Felix, who, desiring to have the approval of the Jews, kept Paul in chains.
